actions.label: Check account balance
actions.mockResponse: Your savings account ending in 4521 has a balance of $12,450.00. Your checking account ending in 7890 has $3,215.67.

actions.label: Block lost/stolen card
actions.mockResponse: Your card ending in 4521 has been temporarily blocked. To get a replacement, visit any PrimaBank branch with a valid ID. Call 1-800-PRIMA for immediate assistance.

actions.label: Dispute a transaction
actions.mockResponse: Your dispute has been logged. A case manager will review it within 2 business days. You can also call 1-800-PRIMA or visit a branch with your ID and account statement for faster resolution.

actions.label: Apply for a loan
actions.mockResponse: Loan applications require identity verification. Please visit any PrimaBank branch with valid IDs and proof of income, or start your application at primabank.com/loans.

actions.label: Transfer funds
actions.mockResponse: To transfer funds, please log in to PrimaBank Online or the mobile app. For wire transfers, visit a branch or call 1-800-PRIMA with your account details and recipient information.

actions.label: Request account statement
actions.mockResponse: Your most recent statement has been sent to your registered email. You can also download statements from PrimaBank Online under Account > Statements.
